protocol.sessionPolicy: fresh agent process, session, HOME, and workspace per run
protocol.startupProbePolicy: model capabilities seeded from the archived endpoint manifest; no pre-trial model request
protocol.longTask: Count from 1 to 120, one number per line, in plain text. Do not use any tools. When finished call complete with result 'counted'.
protocol.shortTask: Reply with just the word pong. Then call complete with result 'pong'.
protocol.analysisUnit: one run; serial/parallel runs paired by block

endpoint.baseUrl: redacted; host identity is not required to replay the protocol

requestConfiguration.toolCalling: text wire format parsed by agent-cli; no native tool_choice
